title: Roxie J NDE 3837
content: I was rear-ended and confused, seeing my car drifting toward the stopped car in front of me when my foot was completely on the brake and I had been fully stopped just seconds prior. I felt as though I was spinning as I bumped the car in front of me. Then looking ahead, I saw them. Two semi's coming at me full force, I could hear the jake brakes; they were about fifty feet from me, one in each lane. I knew I was going to die in the next few moments. I was fully okay with this revelation. Then my world stopped. I saw a bright flash of light brighter than the sun, there was complete silence. Diamonds were in the light shining and falling all around me. I was spinning, flying, floating. It was a warm and pleasant feeling. I came to and realized my car was hanging off the side of an overpass, the airbag was deployed and I was cut by the glass of the windows. I was okay. My head hurt from hitting it. My car was on fire, and I couldn't get out of the door be my car was leaning sideways. A man who was about five feet four inches and 140 lbs came running to my side. He had a cleanly trimmed beard, a soft voice and strong hands. He lifted me out of the window as though I were a child and carried me away from the fire. He sat me down and said I would be all right now. Everything was going to be okay. He reminded me of my grandfather in a strange way. One I cannot describe. When the firemen and police arrived, the man disappeared and I have never seen him since. There is no account of this man, no one saw him, and I don't even know if he was real. But to me he was very real. He pulled me from a burning wreckage, he saved my life.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. Direct head injury 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was heading home for Spring break, the weather was getting bad. I was rear-ended, hit the car in front of me, spun out, and was hit head on by a loaded fuel eighteen-wheeler. The driver said he was traveling at approximately sixty-five mph upon impact. I was driving a Ford Focus. Both vehicles were totaled, the truck driver suffered a broken arm, I suffered aches and pains of the trauma as well as a head trauma that left me unconscious for minutes perhaps.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Billy
elements.At what time during the experience were: Right after I was rear ended when I saw the two eighteen-wheelers coming straight at me, I was fully aware that I was going to be hit by them. I knew my car wouldn't survive it and I believed I wouldn't either. I gave my life up right then, and I felt peace in my heart when they hit me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time seemed to be speeding away and slowing down at the same exact time. Which makes no sense.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Everything was bright and shining full of light. Everything slowed down that I saw but my thoughts sped up simultaneously.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: The last thing I heard was the jake brakes and then there was utter silence. My mind raced through the people I love, and then embraced death. I didn't hear anything until the man came and asked me if I was alright.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain There was a bright light in front of me and it was producing heat, and the diamonds were falling out of the sky. I don't know that I passed through a tunnel but I was getting into brighter and brighter lights.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Someone who pulled me out of my car.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light was extremely white, extremely bright, so bright it distorted all else and made everything else fade into the background. All I could see was the light and the diamonds.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt love, I felt happiness, I felt comfort, I felt peace.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I thought about my family and how they would miss me. I thought of my fiancée and I hoped he would move on after me and find peace. I felt his overwhelming love. Because of this experience we wed fifteen months ahead of schedule, it caused an overwhelming desire in us to begin our life together, not knowing what the future holds or when it might be over.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Uncertain I felt as though life was a special gift and should be appreciated more than it is.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I got married much sooner, we feel much closer and are more cherishing of time together.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I got married much sooner, we feel much closer and are more cherishing of time together. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain I cannot be sure of what happened completely, it was such a confusion and peaceful feeling.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The feeling of peace and understanding to the meaning of life. Love.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The same day as the accident. They believed me, cried with me, and embraced me. My family treated life differently. We enjoy it more and respect it more.
